But of course, the Times doesn’t ID him as such. He’s just a Concerned Youth.
I'm pretty sure that words are not supposed to be put together in this order. It violates some rules, I'm certain.
I can find an AH-64 (tail # R13404) out of Clarksville that flew into Nashville around 11am CST, landed in Whites Creek, and then returned to Clarksville. Sounds like units from Fort Campbell?
